assay: bulk RNA-seq (Lexogen Sense total RNA, paired-end HiSeq 4000) of laser-captured SCN, adult male mice (S4.4.2.p1, S4.3.p1)
sample_inclusion: WT nSVE CT14 n=4, WT SVE ZT14/CT22 n=4, KO nSVE CT14 n=3, KO SVE ZT14/CT14 n=3 (S4.4.2.p1, S2.2.p1, FIG4); only entrained/rhythmic animals used (S4.4.p2)
primary_estimand: Effect of scheduled voluntary exercise (SVE vs nSVE) on the SCN transcriptome, within genotype; the KO comparison is matched for circadian time (CT14), the WT comparison is not (SVE ZT14/CT22 vs nSVE CT14) and the paper states its DEGs mix circadian phase and exercise (S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1)
planned_contrasts: KO SVE vs KO nSVE (S2.5.p1; paper: 223 DEGs, 105 up / 118 down)
WT SVE vs WT nSVE (S2.4.p1; paper: 795 DEGs, 556 up / 239 down; confounded with circadian time)
KO nSVE vs WT nSVE (S2.3.p1; genotype; paper: 307 DEGs, 158 up / 149 down)
KO SVE vs WT nSVE (S2.6.p1; paper: 557 DEGs, 246 up / 311 down)
repeated_measure_unit: none: one SCN sample per animal
paper_method: DESeq2 pairwise analyses with default independent filtering and Cook's distance outlier handling; BH FDR (S4.4.2.p1-p2)
paper_results: DEG counts per contrast as above; genes tested per pairwise analysis 9524 (WT SVE vs nSVE), 15735 (KO SVE vs nSVE), 15269 (WT nSVE vs KO nSVE), 11931 (WT nSVE vs KO SVE) (S4.4.2.p1); KEGG by clusterProfiler, GO BP by topGO (S4.5.p1)
